questions.stem: Why should a respirometer experiment be carried out in a water bath at a constant temperature?

options.text: To speed up respiration as much as possible
To prevent gas volume changes caused by temperature fluctuations
To provide water for the organisms
To keep the organisms alive longer

questions.explanation: Gas expands when heated and contracts when cooled. A water bath keeps temperature constant so that any gas volume changes measured are only due to respiration, not temperature variation.
